quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, as shown in the image?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, it tells the group to move into a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers of a steep hill coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the road curves right and to slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is coming from the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only go when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about road hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. At a stop sign, you must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing downward, it means the driver will slow down or stop. Drivers use hand signals when turn signals are not available or as extra warning.

questions.question: This road sign indicates:

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is coming ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads divided by a median. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is placed with a traffic light to tell drivers that left-turning vehicles do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and diamond-shaped with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road go before you enter.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not permitted in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a winding road ahead, and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down, then swings it down to their side, it signals the group to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. When roads are wet, you should slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In poor conditions, you should always slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that you are about to enter a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right and then left. You should slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the hill ahead.
There are trucks on the hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when they don't have turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Watch carefully for children and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop completely and let other traffic pass before going ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
You can only turn from certain lanes.
Both lanes must merge safely together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road hazards ahead and are usually yellow with black symbols. This sign alerts you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, the right turn symbol is crossed out, so right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules you must follow. This sign tells you to stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign forbids U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when you see it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will enter from the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and let other traffic go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic will merge. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs only mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot pass or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of the overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash along the road ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive with extra care in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead. All traffic in the right lane must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right and then left.
The road ahead curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to react to a yellow or red light.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are in this order:
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: This sign tells you:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must travel at this speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Yield on green for left turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield on green for left turns.
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers turning left at a green light must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is prohibited. This sign means you cannot make U-turns at this location.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about road conditions or hazards ahead.
Directs you to cities and towns.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about road conditions or hazards ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions or hazards on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let other traffic go first.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue through or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane leads off the freeway. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws you must follow. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign means the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it means riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet. Vehicles are harder to control on wet pavement.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What should concern you most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your vehicle is higher.
You might damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You might hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to red, yellow, or green lights and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show turns or stops when turn signals are not available. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, it curves left. You may see several chevron signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs with black markings are regulatory signs. Drivers must obey them. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a highway entrance ramp ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If no one is next to you, move over one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is now a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on a crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop and let vehicles and pedestrians in or heading toward the intersection go first. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane must turn left.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
